notes.title: Galactic Fighters 2.0 Patch and Early Access Ending
notes.content:
News 
-  Добро пожаловать! Now you can conquer the galaxy in russian
- New hud in first person
- Are you a galactic cadet since before the implementation of the achievements and the idea of redo everything to unlock them, makes you turn your head? Don't be afraid, just load your profile to unlock the achievements that you deserve!

 Bugfix 
- Corrected the overlapping of the elements of the HUD in the first person

 Enhancements 
- We made the feedback of the board screen less invasive, and it is activated only in the first person

 Changes 
- The boss 3 is treating its schizophrenia and no longer moves convulsively
- The boss 3, moreover, has noticed that the meteorites have gone out of fashion and now it only shoots lasers

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.13
notes.content:
News 
-  Do you want to show your friends how much are you pro? Now you can show it by unlocking the achievement. Some of the icons are missing, the dog ate them...but they will be soon avaible (Note: no dogs were harmed in the development of the achievements)
 - Do you like playing in first person but you can not understand when you reach the screen boundaries? We've added a new graphical effect which can help you!

 Bugfix 
- After defeating a boss, his life bar no longer appears when you start a new level
- Fixed a bug where the spaceship, if destroyed, shrank
- Fixed some issues that did not allow the elimination of an existing profile
- Fixed a bug where the boss 4 became invincible after having destroyed all its cannons

 Enhancements 
- The collider of boss 3 has been redefined to make it comply with the 3D model 
- Now, when you finish the game in first person, the cockpit is removed before showing statistics

 Changes 
- The words "full screen" and "controller vibration" in the options menu have been enlarged and placed on a single line

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.11
notes.content:
News 
-   New year, new demo
- the soundtracks have been updated with new ones
- the enemies have their beautiful new models
- The HUD has been updated
- The level that you will try has a new skybox!
- The Tonnant  just got back from the body shop for a painting (they also adjusted its body)
- Meatballs? The enemy 3 looks more appetizing... hum, we wanted to say, bad
- Do you remember the enemy 5? No? Neither do we... but now it has a new model

 Bugfix 
- The shop updates correctly when you change profile
- Fixed a bug where, with the sound settings to 0, you could hear the sounds of lasers

 Enhancements 
- Stop play hide and seek! Now the third and the last boss no longer get out of your view
- Sudden vibrations make you have heart attacks? Your friends are suspicious after playing Galactic? Do not worry, now you can disable this (beautiful) feature from the options menu.

Note: There is an error in the version number indicated in the menu (it indicates 12 instead of 11). It's just a graphical error, it does not affect with what's actually in the patch.

notes.title: Early access is almost over!
notes.content:
4 months ago, Galactic Fighters went on early access. It was a very unpolished game at that time, full of bugs and with crappy graphics.

We look at what the game is now, and  we're proud. 
We're proud because you played it anyway, you gave us feedback and helped us in making it a game worth to play. 

But it looks like our journey with GF is going to end (or start?) soon! 
Next month (probably during late february or early march) we're going to release the full, final version of this game we've been working on really really hard just for you.

So, what else there will be in the full version?

 Achievements
 Steam cards
 Every single thing that we released in those 11 patches, which includes: restyled spaceships, enemies and bosses ; new HUD & Menus ; better soundtracks and so on
 Russian language translation (not 100% sure)


In the meanwhile, you can have a look at  Galactic Fighter's soundtrack album here! ːsteamhappyː

See you soon on a spaceship,

StarworkGC's team

notes.title: Galactic Fighters 1.10 Patch Notes
notes.content:
News 
-  The White Eagle just got back from the body shop and now it is ready to fight its enemies.. with style!
- Do not let the first enemy new model fool you. It might be more beautiful but it is still bad.
- Are you tired of dying without noticing it? From today it is impossible. On your screen it will appear a red halo that gets bigger and bigger and your joypad will start to vibrate and scream: "AVOID AT LEAST THE ASTEROIDS!" (Note: the joypad may not scream but, we swear, it will vibrate)

 Bugfix 
- Fixed a bug where some asteroids did not hit the spaceship into mysterious circumstances
- The spaceships no longer move downwards after the movements to the right or to the left
- Fixed a bug related to the soundtrack of the Hangar and of the main menu
- The scroll bar upgrades in the hangar now works correctly 
- Fixed a bug with the bar showing the progress of the spaceship in the level
- Updated the descriptions of shop items.

 Enhancements 
- The pop-up which appears when you click on an unlocked world has been changed so that the text is more readable
- Updated the credits.
- If you click on a world not unlocked, you can not read its mission description

 Changes 
- We added a new skybox in levels 1, 2, 3 and a new great particle effect in levels 1 and 2

notes.title: Galactic Fighters 1.9 Patch notes
notes.content:
News 
- We realized a new model of the "Thunder Lobster" (second spaceship)
- A new soundtrack will accompany you during your boss rush!
- We have added a new victory sound effect for your boss rush!
- After clicking on a new not unlocked world, you will now see a warning message

 Bugfix 
- When you get hit by bullets, you will no longer be shifted
- The main menu will load after loading your profile data
- Now, you cannot shoot while you are in the game pause menu
- We have fixed a bug where the boss rush ended before killing the bosses
- We have fixed a bug where, at the end of the boss rush, the boss life bar was not disabled in other levels
- Now, when you select a world, you will see the description of its first mission
- The boss rush is now unlocked right after finishing level 13 without restarting the game
- The mines thrown by the fourth and the last boss do not pass through the player

 Enhancements 
- The Boss of level 12 has a new IA 
- The system which creates a triangle on the enemies colliding is currently more precise
- The Shop has been reviewed to be more in line with the other game menus
- The waves of the last levels have been reviewed in order to make them possible to overcome

 Changes 
- Now, also levels 10, 11 and 12 have asteroids

notes.title: Galactic Fighters 1.8 Patch notes
notes.content:
News 
-  Once the game ends, a new mode will be unlocked in which you will face all bosses one after the other
- In the main menu, above the store button, there is a new panel of world selection

 Bugfix 
- By changing your profile, the spaceships unlocked are updated
- The level that you just unlocked can be selected in the missions' list
- The oculus do not shoot once they have exceeded your visual range
- You no longer have to restart the game to unlock the ships after slaying a boss
- During the animation of the death of a boss you become immortal
- The end of the levels 2 and 5 coincides with the end of the waves
- In the credits at the end of the game  you will no longer see the interface of the main menu 
- Levels 6 - 9 - 12 do not show the wrong worlds

 Enhancements 
- The spaceship in the hangar, once selected, lifts less from the ground and its animation has been slowed

 Changes 
- The planets and missions not unlocked can not be selected
- Changed the text and animation of pop up of the last level of each world

notes.title: 1.7 Patch notes
notes.content:
News 
- A new main menu has been realized
- The menu of choice of the missions is included in the new main menu, you just need to click on a planet in order to choose a mission
 - We added a button to quickly choose the spacecraft to use; statistics and changes to the power-ups are related to the hangar
- A new model for the "Space Crow" (the first spaceship) was realized
-  A new soundtrack will accompany you during level 13
-  A new soundtrack will accompany you during level 8
- Added new features! During a mission or while you are in the hangar, by pressing "ins" button you can disable or re-enable the GUI
- Added a screen that will notify you of the unlock of new planets or ships

 Bugfix 
- The worlds 1 and 2 are no longer with wrong textures
- If you finish a level when you're on a corner of the screen you will not remain forever wandering in space
- The speed of credits no longer depends on the resolution selected
- Levels 5 and 2 now end after the waves end

 Enhancements 
- The bar of the level does an animation at the end of each wave 

 Changes 
- Increased the duration of animations of the spaceships in the hangar
- Revised the waves of level 10, 11, 12

notes.title: Galactic Fighters 1.4 Patch
notes.content:
News 
- GPs can now be also earnt according to the remaining HP
- the number of taken hits and the amount of dealt damage is now displayed in the end level panel. These stats will not influence the amount of earned points.

 Bugfix 
- the cooldown of the missiles correctly resets when starting a game after dying.
- now enemies do not explode each other
- planets in the selection of missions no longer disappear
- fixed the bug that made upgrades disappearing once unequipped
- the enemies that surpass the player's spaceships do not emit neither sounds nor explosion effects.
- the collision warning system now properly calculates the remaining time before the impact

 Enhancements 
- the marks of the life and level bar dynamically resize if the resolution is changed while in game
- the bonus points earned from a boss and those earned from the enemies have been separated
- camera effects have been added on the levels
- soundtracks have been normalized

 Changes 
- the end-level panel has been reworked
- the spaceship descriptions in the hangar correspond to those of Steam and were translated into four languages.
- asteroids are now faster and invulnerable to bullets but their number has been reduced

notes.title: Galactic Fighters 1.3 Patch
notes.content:
New weekend, new patch!
We've been working a lot on the gameplay, in order to give you more information about your status and your travel. Are you ready? Let's see what's new then:

 News 
- Added full game support for the XBox One joystick
- Added an icon in the HUD, that tells you wether your missiles are in cooldown or not
- Added a level progress bar that tells you wether your near to the end of the level or not
- Added french translation of the descriptions of the missions

 Bugfixes 
- The warning triangle of the collision detector above the Kamikaze enemies (the ones that like to blow up on your face) is now displayed correctly
- The warning triangle of the collision detector is now shown again

 Enhancements 
- Speeded up the loading and playing of the intro video, which now shouldn't cause framerate drops anymore.
- Boosted the performance of the lights inside the hangar menu, which should lag less.

 Changes 
- Changed the style of the Health Bar in order to make it more visible
- The GP rewards gained from bosses and enemies have been adjusted
- Changed the credits soundtrack

notes.title: Galactic Fighters 1.2.1 Patch
notes.content:
Welcome everyone !
We just released the first patch for Galactic Fighters, In which we solved some bugs and added some interesting features to make your gaming experience more fun. Are you ready? Let's start with the following bug fixes and then to the changes...

[BUGFIX]
- [Shop] The third upgrade of the shields category is now purchasable
- The bosses now spawn further away from the player (yes, now you can fairly fight against the boss of the 3rd level  )
- When you create a new profile, the game now automatically selects the first mission as the next one to play therefore the game no longer crashes on first launch [Linux]

[CHANGES]
- The "imminent collision" signals are now showed on asteroids too
- The descriptions of missions have been revised
- The enemies fire rate has been nerfed
- The hangar menu has been completely redesigned
